title: Use existing session freshness for paper valuation marks

exact_a1_provider_behavior.reason: SourceIngestMarkProvider cached the 2330.TW mark from mss-ff49b0e9e567bba38063946a, but its raw 48h (172800s) age check rejected event_time 2026-10-22T00:00:00Z at 2026-10-25T19:19:42Z (328782s > 172800s), while unchanged shared evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness with the same payload, max_refresh_age_seconds=172800, and clock returned (True, None, None).

remediation.summary: Reused the existing evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness rule from services.execution.market_snapshot_admission inside performance_telemetry.py for Taiwan symbols (in both SourceIngestMarkProvider._mark_is_fresh and value_portfolio via _is_mark_fresh). MarketMark preserves the Source snapshot's observed_at, lineage, and calendar_evidence (from top-level calendar_evidence or lineage.calendar_evidence) as non-serialized, non-comparison fields while keeping mark.as_of equal to the true snapshot event_time and mark.source_ref unchanged.
invariants_preserved: Configured max_mark_age_seconds (172800s) and trusted calendar pins (TW_GOVERNED_CALENDAR_PINS) are unchanged
MarketMark.as_of retains true snapshot event_time (2026-10-22T00:00:00Z) and source_ref; current time or observed_at is never relabeled as market time
Genuine missed trading sessions (e.g. evaluating 2026-10-22 close after 2026-10-27 13:30 Asia/Taipei session close) fail closed
Missing/pre-close/stale refresh receipts (observed_at), non-official lineage, missing/tampered/untrusted/malformed calendar evidence, and future event_time/observed_at fail closed
Failed snapshot refresh evicts any previously cached mark (cached-failure behavior preserved)
Non-Taiwan symbols preserve existing flat max_mark_age_seconds (172800s) and future_tolerance_seconds (300s) behavior

boundaries_and_non_claims.missing_approved_expected_drawdown: separate and unsolved; no baseline or zero drawdown invented and no all-12 claim made
